text: Based on the evidence, the 2021 tree-cover loss of about 81.3 ha within the asset was likely caused by timber harvest of the pine plantation. The forest type over the event area was predominantly planted forest (68.1 ha) with species Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. However, the evidence does not establish the exact cause of the change, such as harvest, fire, storm, or clearing. It also does not provide information on the legality or responsibility of the change. The tree-cover loss includes any stand replacement, such as cutting a plantation.
